fact: Car 23 overtaking Car 11 under VSC at 21:19.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 56.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 23 (Alexander Albon), the driver of Car 11 (Sergio Perez), team representatives and reviewed positioning/marshalling system data, video, timing, team radio and in-car video evidence. During the VSC period, Car 23 which was exiting the pits and Car 11 which was on track, arrived at SC2 at the same time. The timing system was unable to determine that there was any diffence in their respective times of arrival at SC2. Video evidence was inconclusive when combined with an examination of the SC/VSC delta times. Each of the team representatives believed that as definitive information was not available at the time, no further action should occur. The stewards agree with this view.
rules_referenced: Article 56.6 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 23 Alleged Overtaking Of Car 11 Under Vsc
